requirements.title: Minimum process authority
requirements.statement: Each runtime component MUST receive only the descriptors, IPC endpoints, credentials, keys, and system capabilities necessary for its assigned role, and MUST NOT retain ambient authority outside that role.
requirements.rationale: Compromise of a network-facing or parsing component must not directly confer archive mutation or long-term identity authority.
initial_conditions: Component role and platform policy are selected
Required descriptors are opened by a trusted launcher
final_conditions: Authority inventory matches the role allow-list
Negative capability probes fail as specified

requirements.title: Descriptor-relative root containment
requirements.statement: The applicator MUST mutate only objects reached from an already-open authorized archive-root descriptor through a verified descriptor chain, without following symbolic links or crossing an unauthorized mount or volume.
requirements.rationale: String sanitation and prefix checks do not prevent substitution races or platform-specific path traversal.
initial_conditions: Authorized root descriptor and expected volume identity are held
Every path component satisfies the canonical name grammar
final_conditions: The operated object remains within the conferred root and allowed volume
Any ambiguity or identity change causes no archive mutation

requirements.title: Authenticated non-downgradable session
requirements.statement: A session MUST mutually authenticate node roles and archive identity, bind the complete negotiation transcript, enforce independent monotonic sequences, and reject replay, cross-context authentication, and protocol downgrade.
requirements.rationale: Transport confidentiality alone does not authorize a peer, archive, message context, or selected protocol semantics.
initial_conditions: Local trust and minimum-version policies are valid
Fresh session entropy is available
final_conditions: Every active message is bound to the authenticated session, direction, type, archive, and sequence
Any failure closes the session without product mutation

requirements.title: Prefix-valid verifiable journal
requirements.statement: The journal MUST be append-only, self-delimiting, versioned, strictly monotonic, cryptographically chained, and recoverable to the longest complete valid prefix without accepting interior corruption or sequence gaps.
requirements.rationale: Recovery and truthful completion require evidence that detects truncation, alteration, reordering, and forks.
initial_conditions: A valid journal head or empty initialized journal exists
Format and resource limits are known
final_conditions: Committed prefix verifies independently
Torn tail is reported and interior corruption is fatal

requirements.title: Plan-bound publication authorization
requirements.statement: The applicator MUST refuse publication unless a valid authorization binds the transaction, peer and archive identities, manifest and canonical plan digests, configuration and capability digests, limits, and destructive summary.
requirements.rationale: A valid signature detached from exact context can authorize content or operations for the wrong archive or environment.
initial_conditions: Manifest, deterministic plan, configuration, and capabilities are verified
Authorization policy and identity are valid
final_conditions: Only the exactly authorized plan can enter publication
Mismatch has no archive mutation effect

requirements.title: Recoverable destructive operations
requirements.statement: Removal MUST default to same-volume quarantine and MUST stop before mutation when archive sentinel, volume identity, source completeness, separate authorization, capacity, retention, or any count, percentage, or volume threshold is not satisfied.
requirements.rationale: Deletion propagation and incomplete source observations can turn ordinary replication errors into irreversible mass loss.
initial_conditions: Complete authenticated source and destructive plan exist
Quarantine and restoration capability are verified
final_conditions: Objects are recoverable for the retention period
Threshold or unknown values cause a hard stop

requirements.title: No silent semantic loss
requirements.statement: For every relevant filesystem semantic, planning MUST classify the target result as LOSSLESS, WRAPPED, UNREPRESENTABLE, POLICY_FORBIDDEN, or UNKNOWN, and MUST refuse UNREPRESENTABLE or UNKNOWN by default.
requirements.rationale: Treating all Unix-like filesystems as equivalent silently corrupts names, metadata, identity, durability, or object meaning.
initial_conditions: Source semantics and target capability vector are available
Session policy is immutable
final_conditions: Every semantic has one explicit result
No lossy or unknown case is silently authorized

requirements.title: Deterministic canonical plan
requirements.statement: Given identical initial state, manifest, immutable configuration, and platform capability vector, the planner MUST produce byte-identical canonical plans independent of map iteration, goroutine scheduling, acquisition order, locale, and wall clock.
requirements.rationale: Authorization and recovery cannot safely bind a plan whose decisions depend on nondeterministic execution order.
initial_conditions: All inputs are canonical and complete
Resource bounds permit planning
final_conditions: Plan bytes and digest are stable
Equivalent repeated/parallel acquisitions produce the same decision

requirements.title: Validated immutable configuration
requirements.statement: Configuration MUST use a versioned deterministic schema, reject unknown critical or ambiguous values before authority acquisition, keep secrets outside ordinary files, and bind an immutable canonical digest to each session.
requirements.rationale: Ambiguous or mutable operational policy can bypass otherwise correct authorization and recovery behavior.
initial_conditions: Configuration bytes and secret references are available
No product authority has been acquired
final_conditions: Configuration is canonical, valid, and immutable for the session
Invalid configuration produces no product side effect

requirements.title: Pre-allocation resource limits
requirements.statement: Every externally influenced length, count, nesting depth, queue, retry, and concurrent task MUST be checked against explicit finite limits before allocation or work admission, with safe refusal on exhaustion.
requirements.rationale: Hostile or damaged peers can otherwise exhaust memory, descriptors, disk, CPU, or work queues and interfere with recovery.
initial_conditions: Validated immutable limits exist
External value has not caused allocation or task admission
final_conditions: Accepted work remains within quotas
Excess produces bounded cleanup and stable error behavior

requirements.title: Idempotent crash recovery
requirements.statement: After interruption at any identified persistence point, recovery MUST preserve authorization and journal-prefix invariants, MUST NOT duplicate publication or confirmation, and repeated recovery MUST converge to the same stable result.
requirements.rationale: Power loss and process termination are expected events and must not create partial success, repeated destructive action, or invented state.
initial_conditions: A valid journal prefix and observed filesystem state are available
No new authority is granted during recovery
final_conditions: State is stable or explicitly quarantined/irrecoverable
Repeated recovery has no additional effect

requirements.title: Attestable reproducible release
requirements.statement: A release MUST publish independently reproducible bit-identical artifacts, complete component inventory, build provenance, test evidence, compiler/environment metadata, digests, signatures, transparency proof where used, and an offline verification path.
requirements.rationale: A signed artifact is not sufficient evidence that it was built from the reviewed source through the declared process.
initial_conditions: All product release gates pass
Separated authorized build and release identities are available
final_conditions: Independent parties can verify source-to-artifact lineage and bit identity
Installation does not require a public online trust service

requirements.title: Assurance record referential integrity
requirements.statement: Every assurance requirement, hazard, threat, verification, specification, evidence status, owner, and approval role MUST use a unique valid identifier where applicable and MUST remain bidirectionally traceable without ambiguous or missing records.
requirements.rationale: Broken or one-way assurance links can make an unverified property appear covered and can turn planned evidence into an implicit claim.
initial_conditions: Machine-readable assurance records and referenced specifications are present
The traceability generator version is fixed by source revision
final_conditions: All identifiers and reciprocal references validate
The checked-in traceability matrix is byte-identical to generated output

requirements.title: Exhaustive native platform optimization
requirements.statement: On every declared platform, Integris MUST discover, prefer, and exercise every applicable stable native operating-system and filesystem facility that improves throughput, latency, durability signaling, zero-copy transfer, cloning, event notification, or confinement for the local role, and MUST NOT ship a release path that leaves such a facility unused when it preserves all higher-criticality requirements. Portable fallbacks MAY exist only as explicitly degraded modes recorded in the capability vector; when a native facility would weaken IC-1 or IC-2, the operation MUST refuse or use a reviewed IP waiver rather than silently select a weaker portable path.
requirements.rationale: A portable lowest-common-denominator daemon that ignores platform-native I/O, cloning, notification, and confinement facilities wastes host capacity, increases exhaustion risk under realistic sync and backup load, and falsely implies full platform support.
initial_conditions: Declared minimum OS version and filesystem capability vector are known
Role-specific native facility inventory for the port is present
final_conditions: Every qualifying native facility is selected or an explicit degraded-mode/IP waiver is recorded
No release artifact claims full platform support while omitting a qualifying native optimization
